name: SAGE-WACV Table 4 dataset (in-depth agentic study, 7 crops)
description: Apple-to-apple test + reference image sets for the 7-crop in-depth Claude agentic study reported in Table 4 (tab:main_results) of the SAGE WACV 2027 paper. Each test image is diagnosed to one disease class; the agent/few-shot methods may consult k reference images per class plus a source-grounded internet knowledge base.
task: Single-label plant-disease classification from one test image. Prediction space = the crop's disease classes (folder names under test/).
label_convention: ground-truth class = the <Class> folder the test image sits in.

Tomato.test_source: TEST=exact Table-4 evaluated ids (results); REFERENCE=github new-crop Tomato dir (19 evaluated classes)

evaluation_protocol.model: Claude Sonnet (paper also reports Haiku/Opus tiers)
evaluation_protocol.metric: top-1 accuracy per crop; mean improvement over the no-KB k=0 baseline
evaluation_protocol.reference_usage: references are drawn from reference/<Class>/ (organ-tagged); the k images shown are selected per method.

reproduction_steps: 1. For each crop, for each test image under test/<Class>/, run the diagnosis method (zero_shot / few_shot / agentic).
2. +KB runs prepend the crop's internet KB (symptom descriptions + anatomical part index) — see kb_source below.
4. correct = (prediction == <Class> folder name). Aggregate top-1 accuracy per crop.
5. Table-4 numbers = Claude Sonnet, internet KB, k in {0,1,4,8}.
kb_source: Self-contained: each crop's kb/ folder (copied from SAGE disease_registry/outputs + Prepared_Dataset). internet.xlsx present for all 7 crops.

provenance.Soybean/Corn/Mango/Tomato: test filenames = exact ids evaluated in SAGE results/open_agentic (Table-4 numbers reproduce); reference images from github.com/tirtho149/SAGE @ new-crop branch Prepared_Dataset (git-LFS).

known_gaps.Tomato_test_images: The exact 88 evaluated Tomato test images draw from mixed sources (Bugwood/CDDM/New_Plant_Di/LeafNet) and are only partially present on disk; filenames are frozen in the split JSON but some image files could not be recovered. Tomato reference set IS complete (145 imgs, 19 classes).

kb_per_crop.internet.xlsx: the +KB symptom descriptions per disease class (source-grounded, with citations) — used by the internet-KB runs.
kb_per_crop.part_index.md / part_index.json: anatomical organ -> disease-class index (candidate narrowing prior).
kb_per_crop.metadata.json: split provenance (seed, ref/test quotas, per-class counts).

verification.recovered_from_CyAg: Tomato test fully recovered (49/49) via CyAg selected_10_crops + Curated_Bugwood_Dataset (exact class+filename); Corn +1 (Crazy_Top/Corn_Disease_71).
verification.residual_missing: RESOLVED: added per user. NOTE — Soybean_Dise_136 and Corn_Disease_202 were sourced by filename from a DIFFERENT class folder (same-name-different-class; exact evaluated image not preserved). Provenance-uncertain for these 2.
